adopt:
# Chrome Web Store:
#   https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/awconnect/peeojgjhjficedkncdejbfnacooodbak
#
# Source (MIT): https://github.com/Aitherium/AitherConnect
# Load unpacked from a checkout of `awconnect/` if you want your own build.
#
# Start a local daemon BEFORE expecting it to pair — `awnode mcp`, or the awsh
# harness on :8362. With no daemon listening it reports
#   "No awdk daemon answered ...; using Cloud"
# and the page goes through the cloud instead of your machine. That fallback
# is deliberate; it is also the thing to check first when it "feels remote".
description:
Kind: pack

What it does
Add the awconnect browser extension: it hands an agent the page you are looking at, pairs over loopback to a local daemon, and falls back to the cloud only when no daemon answers.

Runtime
awdk>=3.8.0
